items.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
items.summary: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.

items.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
items.summary: The company confirmed that the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president.

items.title: Druckenmiller says he is short copper, warns of economic weakness in 2027
items.summary: The billionaire investor is prioritizing capital preservation and shifting his AI focus from infrastructure to applications.

items.title: U.S. Fed Governor Waller pitches keeping central bank at the center of tokenization
items.summary: Waller suggested the Federal Reserve could provide trusted rails for emerging innovation tied to tokenized assets and agentic AI.

items.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
items.summary: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

items.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
items.summary: In addition to that broader estimate, independent audits have uncovered hundreds of separate compatibility problems, with core developers set to reconsider the changes Thursday.

items.title: Decentralized exchange Grvt looks to makes commodity trading more predictable with stable funding perps
items.summary: Grvt’s new Stable Funding Perps tie the cost of holding commodities trades to traditional-market financing costs, rather than volatile crypto-style funding.

items.title: Crypto's 'casino-chips' are disappearing, adding to pain from spot ETF outflows
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 17, 2026

items.title: Ex-OpenAI researcher fund dumps bitcoin miners, cuts IREN 94% after portfolio slump
items.summary: The fund swapped its common stock in Bloom Energy, Nebius and SanDisk for call options, keeping its bet on AI power, computing and memory.

items.title: Bitcoin remains penned in near $64,000 even as ETF outflow streak ends
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down a further 1.0% since midnight UTC at around $64,200, with its bounce from the weekend selloff stalled and pressure building on all fronts.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: CFTC halts some Kalshi Trump mention markets over manipulation concerns
items.summary: The CFTC stayed Kalshi’s Trump-related mention markets after raising concerns about manipulation risks, giving the platform until Dec. 11 to defend its contracts.

items.title: Maple Finance CEO targets up to $15B in assets by the end of 2027
items.summary: Sidney Powell aims to reach $15 billion in assets under management by the end of 2027 as the firm looks to expand into tokenized lending and traditional finance.

items.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
items.summary: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

items.title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
items.summary: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.

items.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
items.summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

items.title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
items.summary: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.

items.title: Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko
items.summary: Solana Foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, its product chief said, as the crypto data platform explores trading features.

items.title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030? ‘Almost certainly not,’ says Dragonfly’s Qureshi
items.summary: Dragonfly’s Haseeb Qureshi says Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030 but doubts it will return to $100,000 by year-end with the rout in AI stocks weighing on crypto.

items.title: ARK sells $85M in Nvidia shares ahead of chipmaker’s Q3 earnings results
items.summary: ARK bought shares in Block, Circle and Coinbase worth about $39.9 million at Monday’s close while selling Nvidia and Solana and Ether staking ETFs.
